name: Sonohed
source:
A surreal and comedic visual novel where you wake up in your hole... headless.

Your head has been stolen by a mysterious character, and you must explore a surreal world to get it back.

Along the way, you will meet strange characters to interact with and make decisions that alter the story.

[Translated from [url=https://fapdos.itch.io/sonohed]itch.io[/url]]
